items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: he was supposed to go into the chapter talking about other piano players like Earl Hines

ctx.x: there isn't any not a whole
chapter on Jelly but he was supposed to go into the chapter talking about other piano players like Earl Hines and I don't know how they were going to work it all in together
But anyway, Jelly was pretty disgusted when he saw the book and that he didn't get any more attention than he did.

items.q: But that might have been something like those Vocalions... when the subject of Simeon came up and also about Earl Hines, that Simeon was working with Hines, he was disgusted that Hines...

ctx.x: He said, here's a man who knows all my pieces and all. He was very pleased. So after talking a while, he said he'd made so many records he couldn't remember all of them. He mentioned, at that time, we didn't know all of his records either and we still probably don't. But he mentioned he'd made some under other names and all too. But that might have been something like those Vocalions. He didn't have his name on all of those. Anyway, when the subject of Simeon came up and also about Earl Hines, that Simeon was…
I don't know any other pianists in the... Do you?
